name: buskothay
description: BusKothay — community bus tracking for AC24, Patuli to Howrah

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @buskothay/geometry && npm run build -w @buskothay/shared
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @buskothay/api && npm run build -w @buskothay/simulator && npm run build -w @buskothay/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @buskothay/geometry && npm run typecheck -w @buskothay/shared && npm run typecheck -w @buskothay/api && npm run typecheck -w @buskothay/simulator && npm run typecheck -w @buskothay/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project geometry --project shared --project api
scripts.simulate: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @buskothay/simulator && node apps/simulator/dist/cli.js
scripts.demo:fleet: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @buskothay/simulator && node apps/simulator/dist/fleet-worker.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run routes:validate && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.build:deploy: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @buskothay/api && npm run build -w @buskothay/simulator && npm run build:deploy -w @buskothay/web
